root_cause.text: The aio_cmd structure is allocated with kmalloc_flex without zeroing, leaving the embedded kiocb's ki_write_stream field uninitialized, which can contain a garbage value exceeding max_write_streams and cause spurious write failures.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "doesn't initialize the aio_cmd->iocb for the ki_write_stream" and "we may get a bogus ki_write_stream value, causing unintended write failure status when checking iocb->ki_write_stream > max_write_streams". The patch changes kmalloc_flex to kzalloc_flex to zero-initialize the allocation, fixing the uninitialized use.
